methods.label: Half-diagonals and triangle perimeter
methods.explanation: The diagonals bisect each other, so \(OA=5\) and \(OB=7\). The perimeter is \(OA+OB+AB=5+7+6=18\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 8 diagonal bisection together with elementary halving and the definition of perimeter.
